exercises.name: Chin nods
steps: Sit tall.
Glide your chin straight back as if making a double chin, eyes level.
Do not tip your head down.
Hold, then relax.
exercises.cue: You should feel the front of your neck working, not the back tightening.
exercises.note: Do these any time you notice your head creeping forward.

exercises.name: Seated band row
steps: Anchor the band at chest height in front of you.
Pull elbows back and slightly down and squeeze the shoulder blades.
Let the band pull your hands forward slowly.
Keep shoulders away from your ears.
exercises.cue: Back and down, not back and up.
exercises.note: If your traps take over, use a lighter band.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
steps: Hold a light band at chest height, arms straight but soft at the elbow.
Pull the band apart by rotating your arms outward.
Squeeze the shoulder blades gently.
Stop when your hands are in line with your shoulders.
exercises.note: Do not go past the line of your shoulders. Hypermobile shoulders do not need extra range.
exercises.targets: rear delts, rotator cuff, mid traps

exercises.name: Wall slide with serratus push
steps: Stand facing a wall with forearms on it.
Push the wall away so your shoulder blades wrap around your ribs.
Slide your forearms up as far as you can without your shoulders hiking up.
Slide back down slowly.
exercises.note: Only go as high as you can keep your shoulders low.

exercises.name: Side-lying external rotation
steps: Lie on your LEFT side with a pillow under your head and between your knees.
Rest the right elbow on a small rolled towel at your ribs, forearm across your belly.
Rotate the forearm up toward the ceiling slowly.
Lower for a count of 3.
exercises.cue: Elbow stays pinned to the towel.
exercises.note: Left side-lying is the comfortable side in late pregnancy. Right arm is the priority. Do the left arm too if you like.

exercises.name: Seated thoracic extension
steps: Sit in a chair with a firm back at about shoulder-blade height.
Put your hands behind your head.
Gently lean back over the chair so the bend happens in your upper back.
Keep your ribs down. Come back up slowly.

exercises.name: Lacrosse ball on the wall
steps: Place the ball between you and the wall.
Find the tight spot and lean in lightly.
Make tiny slow movements.
Breathe out as the spot softens.
exercises.note: Never on the spine or the front or sides of the neck.
exercises.targets: right upper trap near neck; between right shoulder blade and spine
spots: top of right shoulder near neck
between right shoulder blade and spine

exercises.name: Incline chest-supported row
steps: Set the bench to about 30 to 45 degrees.
Lie face-down with chest on the pad, head just above the top.
Let the dumbbells hang.
Row elbows up and back, squeeze shoulder blades, lower for 3 seconds.
exercises.note: The pad takes the lower back out so the work lands in the mid back.

exercises.name: Band face pull
steps: Anchor the band at about face height.
Pull the band toward your forehead, hands apart, elbows high.
Rotate forearms up and out at the end.
Pause 1 second, return slowly.
exercises.cue: Do not lean back to cheat.
exercises.note: Best single exercise for rounded shoulders.
exercises.targets: rear delts, external rotators, lower traps

exercises.name: Serratus wall push-up plus
steps: Hands on a wall at shoulder height, body in a straight line.
Do a small push-up.
At the top push the wall away a little further so the shoulder blades spread around your ribs.
Hold 1 second.
exercises.cue: Spread the shoulder blades at the top.
exercises.note: Progress to a hands-on-bench version after a few weeks.

exercises.name: Incline Y raise
steps: Same incline bench, chest on the pad.
Lift your arms out and up in a Y with thumbs up.
Lead with the lower traps, shoulder blades toward back pockets.
Lower slowly.
exercises.cue: Start with no weight if your neck takes over.

exercises.name: Bird dog
steps: On hands and knees with a flat back.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back.
Hold 2 seconds, then switch.
Keep hips level, do not let the low back arch.
exercises.note: Good postpartum core and shoulder-stability combo.
